content: Portfolio rebalancing involves periodically adjusting asset allocation to maintain desired risk levels. Market fluctuations cause portfolios to drift from target allocations, requiring strategic buying and selling. A disciplined rebalancing approach helps control risk, maintain consistency with investment goals, and can improve long-term returns through disciplined contrarian actions.
